title: The Antichrist
lead: The word "antichrist" never appears in Revelation. It is found only in John's letters (1 John 2:18, 22; 1 John 4:3; 2 John 7), where John says "many antichrists" have already come. The Greek anti can mean both "against" and "in place of": an antichrist opposes Christ by imitating him.
